export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec113/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib
g=json.load(open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-goal-spec.json'))
print(hashlib.sha256(g['original_goal'].encode()).hexdigest(), g.get('original_goal_hash'))
r=json.load(open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-c24-receipt.json'))
print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['repo_root','content_roots','local_state_paths','mode','write_mode']},indent=1,ensure_ascii=False))
import os
print(os.path.realpath(r['content_roots']['repository'])==r['repo_root'])
rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-intermediate.jsonl') if l.strip()]
print(len(rows)); print(json.dumps(rows[-1],ensure_ascii=False,indent=1)[:3000])
PY
ls -la eval-log system-spec eval-log/system-spec-harness .dev-graph; git status --short; git diff --stat
